name: prusti-assistant
description: Verify Rust programs with the Prusti verifier.

commands.title: verify the current crate or file
get information for current crate or file without verification
Query the signature of a method to create external specification

enumDescriptions: A version with frequent updates that might be unstable or have other issues.
A local build of Prusti, specified via localPrustiPath.
prusti-assistant.buildChannel.description: Specifies from which channel Prusti builds are downloaded.

prusti-assistant.checkForUpdates.description: Specifies if Prusti should check for updates at startup.

prusti-assistant.localPrustiPath.description: Specifies the path to the local Prusti installation (has no effect if buildChannel is not set to Local).

prusti-assistant.verifyOnSave.description: Specifies if programs should be verified on save.

prusti-assistant.verifyOnOpen.description: Specifies if programs should be verified when opened.

prusti-assistant.reportErrorsOnly.description: Specifies if only error messages should be reported, hiding compiler's warnings.

prusti-assistant.javaHome.description: Specifies the path of the Java home folder (leave empty to auto-detect).

prusti-assistant.serverAddress.description: Specifies the address of a Prusti server to use for verification. If not set, the extension will start up and manage its own server.

prusti-assistant.extraPrustiEnv.description: Specifies additional environment variables to be passed to all Prusti runs. Remember to restart the Prusti Server after modifying this setting.

prusti-assistant.extraPrustiRustcArgs.description: Specifies additional arguments to be passed to Prusti-Rustc. Used when verifying a Rust file that is not part of a crate.

prusti-assistant.extraCargoPrustiArgs.description: Specifies additional arguments to be passed to Cargo-Prusti. Used when verifying a crate.

prusti-assistant.extraPrustiServerArgs.description: Specifies additional arguments to be passed to the Prusti Server. Remember to restart the Prusti Server after modifying this setting.

prusti-assistant.contractsAsDefinitions.description: If enabled you can use 'goto definition' to view contracts of function calls.

prusti-assistant.reportViperMessages.description: If enabled more information about quantifiers is available. This feature has to be enabled also server-side (done by this extension).

prusti-assistant.reportBlockMessages.markdownDescription: If viper messages and this option are enabled more small-grained verification. This feature has to be enabled also server-side (done by this extension). This requires `#prusti-assistant.reportViperMessages#` to be set too.

prusti-assistant.blockUpdateInterval.description: If block data is reported, this setting regulates how frequently the UI is updated. If it acts unstably or flickers, increasing this number might help.

prusti-assistant.forceBlockUpdateInterva.markdownDescription: When blocks hang, the currently displayed state may be out of date. This can happen, when no new messages arrive after reaching a hanging block (i.e. no other paths are active anymore) and the hanging block message arrived between `#prusti-assistant.blockUpdateInterval#`. This setting regulates forced updates after the specified amount of ms.

prusti-assistant.z3QiProfileFreq.description: The frequency in which Z3 should report quantifier instantiations. The lower this value, the slower Z3 becomes. Used to display quantifier information. Only considered when reportViperMessages is set.

prusti-assistant.extraSiliconArgs.markdownDescription: Specifies additional environment variables to be passed to all Silicon runs. Remember to restart the Prusti Server after modifying this setting. If `#prusti-assistant.reportBlockMessages#` is set, the default value receives an additional `--numberOfErrorsToReport 0`. May be overruled by `#prusti-assistant.extraPrustiEnv#`. A list of option can be found in the [Silicon wiki](https://github.com/viperproject/silicon/wiki/Command-Line-Options).

enumDescriptions: A fixed version of Prusti, specified via prustiTag.
A local build of Prusti, specified via localPrustiPath.
prusti-assistant.prustiVersion.description: Specifies from which version of Prusti should be used.

prusti-assistant.prustiTag.description: Specifies the GitHub tag of the Prusti release to be used. Visit https://github.com/viperproject/prusti-dev/releases to see all the available tags. This setting is only used if prustiVersion is set to Tag.
